name: Portainer
description: Imports Docker environments, stacks and containers from Portainer into the knowledge graph (server, stack, container, "runs on", "part of") and shows AI clients their state. Settings: url (e.g. https://portainer.example.org:9443) and token (Portainer access token; a read-only user is enough).

mcpTools.name: portainer.sync
mcpTools.description: Import Portainer environments, stacks and containers into the knowledge graph now.

mcpTools.name: portainer.containers
mcpTools.description: State, image and published ports of all containers in all Portainer environments.
